metadata.description: Phase 5 (Community): visual mode editor, mode registry with signing and a verified badge, carrier PCB, translations, build guides, community processes. Refreshed 2026-10-22 after phases 2-4 software (decisions P5R-1 to P5R-14); plan phases 1 (the visual mode editor) and 2 (the editor and the simulator: field.lua shown in the web view, POST /api/reload, the editor's Test button, decisions P5B-1 to P5B-7) built in software; plan phase 13 (missing modes sent to boxes from the GM console, the maintainer's P5R-8; P5B-8 to P5B-17) planned. Plan phases 3 (the editor's geo, GM command, role and kind blocks, screens; P5C-1 to P5C-7), 4 (signed mode packages: canonical ustar archive, Ed25519 manifest, tools/mode_package.py, registry index schema, shared vectors; P5C-8 to P5C-13), 5 (the sandbox-escape battery, which closed two watchdog escapes; P5C-14 to P5C-16) and 6 (signed packages in the controller and console; P5C-17 to P5C-21) built in software; P5B-9 answered by the maintainer (firmware-built mode keys only).
awaiting_maintainer: P5C-1 to P5C-21 (design choices of plan phases 3-6, open)
planned_plan_phases: 13 (missing modes from the GM console, after 6)
